notes: DUPLICATE-COMPANY CHECK (per brief): read c7.json (Anthropologie Home, USA) first. Verified anthropologie.com is NOT a single shared catalogue for both markets - a genuine, materially distinct UK storefront exists at the /en-gb/ locale path. Evidence: (1) anthropologie.co.uk and anthropologie.eu both 301/302-redirect to https://www.anthropologie.com/en-gb/ (curl -D- confirmed both hosts resolve and forward there). (2) Requesting /en-gb/ shows a genuine interstitial ('We've redirected you to our US site... Take me to the GB site') with a distinct 'Shop the UK Site' toggle - proving GB is a separate selectable storefront, not just a currency wrapper. (3) Prices throughout /en-gb/ render natively in GBP (£), not USD-with-a-symbol-swap. (4) The GB top nav is structurally different from the US nav: US combines 'Home & Furniture' as one item (see c7); GB splits it into separate 'Home & Decor' and 'Furniture' items and also has a standalone 'Petite' nav item the US site lacks. (5) GB category URL slugs do not mirror US slugs at all - e.g. https://www.anthropologie.com/en-gb/pendant-lighting 404s ('we can't seem to find what you're looking for') even though US /pendant-lighting is a live category (c7); the GB equivalent lives at a completely different slug (/en-gb/lighting-ceiling etc). (6) UK-mandatory legal disclosures unique to this locale: Modern Slavery Act statement, Gender Pay Reporting Statement, Klarna/Clearpay (UK BNPL providers), Student/Key-Worker Discount pages. (7) Distinct EU/UK social handles in the GB footer (@anthropologieEU on Instagram/TikTok/Pinterest, /AnthropologieEurope on Facebook) vs the US site's own handles. (8) robots.txt lists separate per-locale sitemap indexes (en-gb, fr-fr, de-de, it-it, es-es, en-ca, anthrohome, and the bare US one) - confirming distinct crawlable catalogues per country, not one shared sitemap. (9) The product POPULATION is materially smaller/different, not just re-priced: GB 'Paintings & Prints' (/en-gb/artwork) = 351 products vs US 'Art Prints' alone (c7) = 1352; GB 'Vases' (/en-gb/decor-vases, site currently labels it 'Summer Vases') = 46 vs US 'Vases' = 165; GB 'Mirrors' single bucket = 111 vs US split Wall/Floor/Mantel Mirrors totalling 173. This is the opposite pattern from S.N. 28 HAY US/UK (identical catalogue) and matches instead the confirmed-distinct pattern used for Westwing/H&M-Home per-country siblings elsewhere in this project. CONCLUSION: genuinely distinct UK storefront - extracted fresh from https://www.anthropologie.com/en-gb/, not a duplicate-company case. Access route: anthropologie.com is DataDome-protected (direct curl and WebFetch both blocked/403; robots.txt itself only serves through the same protection). Reached entirely via the r.jina.ai reader proxy, which returns fully rendered GB PLPs including the site's own 'N products' header (each qty below is echoed identically 3x on its own page - in the H1 area, the sort bar, and the results-count re-statement - which was treated as the empirical count per Rule 1; no Shopify/inflated-API count was used). robots.txt carries no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai disallow. Category tree taken from the GB 'Home & Decor' mega-nav (https://www.anthropologie.com/en-gb/home, 3464 products total across the whole Home/Furniture/Textiles umbrella) and its child listing pages. Scope restricted to Home Decor per project rules; excluded: Furniture (whole top-nav branch), Bedding, Curtains (fabric), Cushions & Throws, Rugs, Soft Furnishings, Bathroom Textiles, Table Linens, Doormats, Wallpaper, Paint, Books/Stationery & Games, Kids Collection, Gourmet Food & Drink, Cooking Utensils & Appliances, Handles & Knobs and Bathroom Hardware (functional cabinet/plumbing hardware, under the 'Hardware' node), and 'Candles & Home Fragrance' (293 products, scented candles/home fragrance with no separate unscented-candle-holder listing of its own - unscented candle holders are already covered inside 'Decorative Objects'). 'Shelves & Storage' (/en-gb/room-wall-decor-shelves, 99 products, titled 'Shelves & Brackets') was dropped as a mixed roll-up after inspecting titles: it interleaves genuine decorative wall shelves (e.g. 'Betti Shelf') with storage boxes and jewellery boxes with no clean sub-split available - per the 'mixed roll-ups: drop, don't pad' rule. 'The Shade Shop' (/en-gb/mix-and-match-lighting, 40 products) was dropped as a facet/merchandising duplicate of 'Lampshades' (/en-gb/lighting-shades, 38 products) after comparing product-slug sets: 9+ of the first 20 product slugs on each page were identical (e.g. addison-ross-stripe-empire-lamp-shade, dana-gibson-leopard-lamp-shade, woven-seagrass-empire-lamp-shade) - same population re-cut, not a distinct category. Rule 0 gain: included 'Hooks' (/en-gb/hardware-hooks, 45 products, 'Coat Hooks, Wall Hooks & Door Hooks') and 'Curtain Poles & Tiebacks' (/en-gb/curtain-hardware, 34 products, titled 'Curtain Accessories | Poles & Tiebacks') under the brief's explicit 'decorative hooks... curtain rods, curtain tiebacks' INCLUDE line, even though both sit inside a broader 'Hardware' node whose sibling children (Handles & Knobs, Bathroom Hardware) were correctly excluded as functional cabinet/plumbing hardware - judged on product type, not the parent node's name.
